content: Eclipse Foundation trademark policy: project names/logos/acronyms are Eclipse Foundation IP. A derivative product may NOT incorporate an Eclipse project trademark into its own product name; permitted forms are '<product> for <Eclipse project>' or '<product>, <Eclipse project> Edition'. So a Theia-sidecar product must not be named e.g. 'PowerBrowser Theia'; the Theia name can only appear as attribution. Theia itself supports rebranding via package.json theia.frontend.config.applicationName plus custom about/welcome contributions.
